entities.summary: Jordi Cuixart i Navarro is a Catalan businessman and cultural activist. He was the president of Òmnium Cultural, a non-profit cultural organisation founded in 1961 with more than 190,000 members and 52 local branches in Catalonia, from December 2015 to February 2022.
